goal: Let the business assistant recall indexed NAS supplier prices for both historical-price lookup and new project quotation drafts, while keeping calculations traceable and missing prices explicit.

acceptance_criteria.description: A new project quotation request triggers NAS memory retrieval even when the user does not explicitly say history, while unrelated fresh creative work remains excluded.
Quotation context includes the matched document chunk, source path, and review status so the assistant can cite the exact historical price evidence.
New quotation output is constrained to a quotation draft with itemized calculations, separated tax and delivery costs, source citations, and explicit pending-inquiry labels for missing prices.
Quotation retrieval combines governed historical project memory with raw NAS supplier-price documents instead of allowing the governed-memory result to mask price evidence.
Quotation searches rank budget documents and matched unit-price evidence ahead of general execution plans with similar project keywords.

runtime_policy.source_of_truth: NAS originals and indexed curated supplier notes
runtime_policy.missing_price_policy: 标记待询价，不编造单价
runtime_policy.calculation_policy: 数量乘单价形成小计；税费、运输、安装、加急、损耗和利润单独列示
runtime_policy.citation_policy: 使用历史价格时必须标明来源和资料状态
